nodes.description: Mapping from tokenId to Auction struct holding seller, bid state, timing and price data.

Percentage share of sale price kept by the marketplace.

Extra window added after the last bid before an auction can settle.
Mapping of tokenId to bidder to amount owed when a refund transfer fails.
Initializer that sets up upgradeable parents and default auction timing.
Owner-only setter binding the NFTation contract and marketplace share.
Owner-only function to update the marketplace share percentage.
Owner-only function to update auction and extend durations with validation.
Creates an auction and pulls the NFT from the seller into escrow.
Places a bid, refunds the previous bidder and updates auction timing state.
Finalizes a finished auction, distributing marketplace share, royalty and seller proceeds.
Seller-cancel of an auction with no bids, returning the NFT.
Seller-only update of minimum bid price before any bid exists.
Internal view computing marketplace and royalty splits for a price.

View returning the Auction struct for a tokenId.

edges.reason: createAuction writes minBidPrice, seller and initiated into the auctionMapping struct.
createAuction uses NFTationContract to escrow the NFT.
placeBid reads and writes auctionMapping bid state.
placeBid reads auctionDuration to compute auction end.
placeBid reads auctionExtendDuration in expiry checks.
placeBid writes pendingWidthrawMapping when refund fails.
settle loads and deletes the auctionMapping entry.
settle calls NFTationContract for first-sale and transfer operations.
settle reads marketplace share via getMarketShareAndRoyalty.
cancelAuction reads and deletes the auctionMapping entry.
cancelAuction calls NFTationContract.transferFrom to return the NFT.
changeMinBidPrice reads seller state and writes minBidPrice.
getMarketShareAndRoyalty queries NFTationContract for first-sale and royalty data.
getMarketShareAndRoyalty uses marketPlaceShare in split computation.
withdraw reads and zeroes pendingWidthrawMapping balance.
initialize sets the default auctionDuration.
initialize sets the default auctionExtendDuration.
initToken assigns NFTationContract.
initToken assigns marketPlaceShare.
changeMarketPlaceShare writes marketPlaceShare.
setAuctionTiming writes auctionDuration.
setAuctionTiming writes auctionExtendDuration.
getAuctionMapping reads the auctionMapping entry.
getPendingWidthrawMapping reads pendingWidthrawMapping.
createAuction records msg.sender as the auction seller and transfer origin.
placeBid uses msg.sender as bidder and compares against the seller.
settle emits msg.sender as the caller.
cancelAuction authorizes the caller against auction.seller.
changeMinBidPrice authorizes the caller against auction.seller.
withdraw indexes pending balances and pays msg.sender.
placeBid uses block.timestamp for auction expiry and extension logic.
settle uses block.timestamp to determine whether the auction finished.
createAuction performs an external NFT transferFrom call.
placeBid performs a low-level call to refund the previous bidder.
settle performs a low-level call paying the marketplace owner.
settle performs a low-level call paying the token creator royalty.
settle performs an external NFT transferFrom to the winner.
settle performs a low-level call paying the seller.
cancelAuction performs an external NFT transferFrom to the seller.
withdraw performs a low-level call paying the caller.
settle invokes getMarketShareAndRoyalty to compute payout splits.
Refund call hands control to the previous bidder who may re-enter placeBid.
Owner payout call can re-enter settle if the recipient is a contract.
Royalty payout call can re-enter settle.
Seller payout call can re-enter settle.
Withdraw payout call hands control to the caller who may re-enter withdraw.
createAuction indexes auctionMapping with the _tokenId parameter.
createAuction stores _minBidPrice into the auction.
placeBid indexes the auction using the _tokenId parameter.
settle reads the auction via the _tokenId parameter.
cancelAuction reads the auction via the _tokenId parameter.
changeMinBidPrice indexes the auction using _tokenId.
changeMinBidPrice writes _newMinBidPrice into the auction.
withdraw indexes pendingWidthrawMapping with _tokenId.
initToken assigns the passed NFTation contract address.
initToken stores the passed share percentage.
changeMarketPlaceShare assigns the new share to state.
setAuctionTiming writes _auctionDuration to state.
setAuctionTiming writes _auctionExtendDuration to state.
Cached lastBidBidder is the recipient of the refund external call.
Cached lastBidAmount is the value sent by the refund external call.
Computed marketplace share flows into the owner payout call.
Computed royalty amount flows into the royalty payout call.
Resolved token creator is the recipient of the royalty payout call.
Computed remaining amount flows into the seller payout call.

Local copies the previous bidder used as refund recipient.
Local copies the previous amount sent by the refund call.
Local flag tracking first-bid state inside placeBid.
Local computed end timestamp emitted by placeBid.
Local marketplace share amount sent by the owner payout call.
Local royalty amount sent by the royalty payout call.
Local creator address that receives the royalty call.
